technical_requirements: Index scale: ~12M docs, expect 300-500M vectors after chunking
Latency SLO: p95 <= 150ms (goal 80-100ms) for 1–3 candidate generations + rerank
Cost sensitivity: budgeted ARR target -- see estimated_arr_range
Reranking: cross-encoder reranker for top-50 candidates, GPU-accelerated for latency
Embedding strategy: chunking by section, per-patient prefix caching, semantic deduping
Vector store preferences: managed FAISS or RedisVector w/ VPC peering (open to Redwood-managed if private connectivity guaranteed)
Data handling: PHI in vectors allowed only if encrypted with customer KMS; strict retention policies required
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-query audit log with user-id and patient-id hash
sales_notes: CTO (Anika Rao) quote: 'We can't afford recall regressions — safety and auditability first. If latency or traceability suffers, clinicians won't adopt.' Wants clear rollback & fallback to older model versions. Strong interest in Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce token spend for routine searches.
poc_scope: Ingest 200k notes (de-identified subset), run 2 embedding families, evaluate ANN candidates (HNSW vs IVF) + GPU reranker. Deliver metrics: recall@5, p95 latency, cost per 1k queries, audit log proof-of-concept.
poc_outcomes: Baseline: embeddings (open-embedding-v2) + FAISS IVF -> recall@5 0.78; adding cross-encoder reranker -> recall@5 0.92. Latency p95 for combined pipeline: 220ms on shared hosted test infra (too high). Next step: test on Dedicated GPUs and with KV/prefix caching to hit 100-150ms range.
